_meta.description: Site quirks and learned tips database for autonomous browser navigation

quirks.quirk: Unsaved post/reel navigation triggers native beforeunload prompt
quirks.advice: Auto-bypassed by navigate, or use browser_handle_dialog to accept.

quirks.quirk: Reels and Posts use Draft.js / Lexical rich text editors
quirks.advice: browser_type handles this natively via CDP Input.insertText with auto-selection clearing.

quirks.quirk: Media upload buttons open OS file picker
quirks.advice: Always use browser_upload_file tool with absolute filePath to bypass OS file dialog.

quirks.quirk: Search input accepts Enter key directly
quirks.advice: Use browser_type with pressEnter: true to immediately submit queries.
Use browser_get_dom and ref-based browser_click rather than eval.

quirks.quirk: Daraz popup discount banner appears on first visit
quirks.advice: Click the close button on the discount modal if present
